voice: a raw chat transcript between the user and their assistant, plus short system notes from the assistant's memory service
format: timestamped chat lines like '[2024-03-05 18:42] user: ...' and '[...] assistant: ...'; rules and facts appear as things the user said in chat or as '(memory)' system lines; the pending item is the latest message at the end
verbosity: conversational, medium length; casual phrasing, contractions, occasional typos in the user's lines but never inside VERBATIM strings
notes: Use ISO-like timestamps for chat lines. Keep each dated fact attached to its own dated line.
